A techno-economic analysis of a 100,000 TPY DAC facility employing Susteon’s structured sorbent filter technology found that marginal improvements in the sorbent performance resulted in a substantial reduction in the cost of CO capture. The cost of capture of the DAC 2 process is estimated to be $241/tonne CO . With additional improvement to the sorbent kinetics and 2 working capacity, there is a pathway to reach a cost of capture of $165/tonne CO . 2 The milestones and deliverables completed for this project are outlined in Table 1.
